edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, granting full privilege to an untrusted caller.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before nominating a new owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
owner state variable is read by the onlyOwner authorization check.
transferOwnership writes the caller-supplied address into newOwner.
acceptOwnership reads owner for the event and overwrites it with newOwner.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner for the check and then clears it to address(0).
Constructor writes the token symbol.
Constructor writes the token name.
Constructor writes the decimals value.
Constructor sets the fixed total supply.
Constructor credits the whole supply to the hardcoded beneficiary address.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from _totalSupply.
balanceOf returns balances[tokenOwner].
Caller-supplied tokenOwner indexes the balances mapping.
transfer debits and credits the balances mapping.
transfer relies on safeSub for balances[msg.sender] - tokens; an unchecked underflow would mint balance.
transfer relies on safeAdd for balances[to] + tokens against overflow.
msg.sender is used as the debit account in transfer.
to parameter flows into the recipient balances entry and Transfer event.
tokens parameter flows into both safe math operations.
approve overwrites allowed[msg.sender][spender].
msg.sender is the owner key of the allowance being granted.
spender parameter is the inner allowance key.
tokens parameter becomes the new allowance value.
transferFrom debits balances[from] and credits balances[to].
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom uses safeSub for both balances[from] and the spender allowance.
transferFrom uses safeAdd for balances[to].
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is consumed.
from parameter indexes both balances and allowed.
to parameter receives the credited balance.
tokens parameter drives both subtractions and the addition.
allowance simply reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
tokenOwner parameter is the outer allowance key.
spender parameter is the inner allowance key.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
msg.sender is both the allowance owner and the from argument of receiveApproval.
approveAndCall performs an external call into the attacker-supplied spender contract.
receiveApproval is a callback into arbitrary spender code that can interact with the token again.
spender parameter selects the callback target contract.
tokens parameter is both the allowance and the callback amount.
data parameter is forwarded verbatim to the external callback.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call on a caller-supplied token address.
The arbitrary token contract controls the return value of the external transfer call.
tokenAddress parameter determines the callee of the external call.
tokens parameter is forwarded to the external transfer.
onlyOwner gates the privileged rescue function.
Any caller may hit the fallback, which unconditionally reverts.

safeAdd performs the addition and validates require(c >= a).
safeSub performs the subtraction after require(b <= a).
safeMul performs the multiplication and validates require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
safeDiv performs the division after require(b > 0).
Local c is the unchecked intermediate sum that the overflow check validates.
Local c is the result of the guarded subtraction.
Local c is the unchecked intermediate product that the overflow check validates.
Local c is the result of the guarded division.
